This is Coqau. She's a giant Welsummer and she's in love with me.

I don't know anything about the breed. We have a few buff orpington hens for eggs. They are very docile and lay regularly enough to supply my wife and I our needs. We may add a new hen in a year or so. She has pretty markings. What is her demeanor? Ours are truly backyard chickens.

She was really skittish when we had a rooster, but once the rooster was out of the picture she got super sweet. Now she runs up to me when ever I come outside and she does her submissive squat and makes happy noises when I scratch her back. All of our birds are hand raised and super sweet, except the black bantam we have. She's a rescue and kind of an ass hole, but she lays good eggs every other day or so, and she's too small to eat so we keep her around. Ours are definitely more pet than farm animal. We rescued a leghorn who had a bad respiratory infection. I had to give her injections of antibiotics. And I rubbed her down with vet rx and hand fed yoghurt and seeds by hand. Now she thinks I'm her boyfriend. When the sun goes down she come and taps on the back door to let us know she's ready to come in and go to her cage. The whole chicken experience has been really fun and fulfilling.
